source: Example single-channel calibration (one fibre imaged across the whole detector).
wavelength_formula: nm = a*x^2 + b*x + c   (x = pixel index)
notes: Single-channel example: ONE fibre across the full detector, NO reference channel.

Load via the Calibrate dialog's Load... button or the CLOUDS_CALIBRATION env var. With no reference channel the Engine hides the reference trace, the ratio (transmission/absorbance) views fall back to counts, and the cursor/stats show 'ref --'. Recalibrate the linear b/c against your real STD/EDU unit.
For a 3648-px STD set pixels=3648 and pixel_window [0, 3647].
